name: Quest Tracker
description: A compact pinned-objective section projected from progression.quest_log. It orders tracked quests, exposes objective progress and ready-to-turn-in state, and briefly acknowledges completion. The quest log remains the sole authority for acceptance, progress, completion, and rewards.

outputs.name: trackedQuests
outputs.description: Read-only projections as {questId, title, objectives, state, pinned}; objective progress includes current, target, and optional display text.

provenance: Added 2026-10-29 with the Adventure Interface Shell UI pack (84ece01). Provenance written after the fact on 2026-10-29: it landed recording only "library-native". Nearest in a catalogue search: progression.quest_log, the authority this projects from, and progression.level_objective_set; it owns only which objectives are pinned and how they are shown. Library-native.
